keyword: how can i watch the artemis 2 launch

verifications.claim: The Artemis II launch is on April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'watch the launch countdown live on April 1'; R3: 'leaving Earth on April 1'; R4: 'lifted off ... at 6:35 p.m. EDT' on April 1, 2026 context; R5: 'lift off ... on April 1'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the launch date as April 1, 2026.

verifications.claim: Artemis II launch coverage includes 24/7 launch pad views.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'NASA's live coverage typically includes ... views from the launchpad'; R4: '24/7 coverage will continue on NASA’s YouTube channel'
verifications.reasoning: Sources mention launchpad views in coverage and 24/7 YouTube coverage, but not explicitly '24/7 launch pad views' together.

verifications.claim: Artemis II launch coverage includes fueling coverage.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Live coverage of filling the rocket's tanks with fuel is expected to begin at 7:45 a.m. ET'; R4: tanking operations coverage from 7:44 a.m.; R5: '7:45 a.m. EDT ... Fueling coverage'
verifications.reasoning: Direct mentions of fueling/tanking coverage in multiple sources.

verifications.claim: Artemis II launch countdown starts around 7:45 a.m. EDT.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R4: countdown started 'Monday at 4:44 p.m. EDT'; R5: '7:45 a.m. EDT ... Fueling coverage' (not countdown); '12:50 p.m. EDT ... full Artemis 2 launch countdown coverage'
verifications.reasoning: Countdown began earlier on Monday; 7:45 a.m. is fueling coverage start, not countdown.

verifications.claim: Coverage of SLS rocket fueling begins at 7:45 a.m. EDT on April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Live coverage of filling the rocket's tanks with fuel ... at 7:45 a.m. ET Wednesday [April 1]'; R4: tanking from 7:44 a.m.; R5: '7:45 a.m. EDT ... Fueling coverage of the SLS rocket'
verifications.reasoning: Precise match on time, date, and fueling coverage.

verifications.claim: Full launch countdown coverage starts at 12:50 p.m. EDT on April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'NASA+ ... starting at 12:50 p.m. ET'; R4: 'Full launch coverage begins at 12:50 p.m.'; R5: '12:50 p.m. EDT ... NASA full Artemis 2 launch countdown coverage'
verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmation of full countdown coverage start time.

verifications.claim: The scheduled liftoff time for the Artemis II launch is ~6:35 p.m. EDT on April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'lifted off from ... at 6:35 p.m. EDT' on April 1 (actual matches ~scheduled)
verifications.reasoning: R4 confirms liftoff at exactly 6:35 p.m. EDT on April 1; other sources note window opening at 6:24 p.m., but actual/scheduled aligns.
